styles.name: Acoustic Sculpture

signature.color_and_material: Warm ivory ground, oxidized copper surfaces and deep blue text; warm flat controls remain separate from shaded metal.
signature.composition: A narrow humanist invitation accompanies a large seven-plate instrument; B is a three-part character workbench with a real comparison tray.
signature.content_rhythm: A moves from a singular object into three spatial stories; B begins with controls and compares saved character/scenario configurations.
signature.imagery: Original depth-tested WebGL sculpture of seven matte copper plates, directional light and an informative authored SVG fallback.
signature.interaction: Scenario and Ramu/Gyva/Sodru choices alter the instrument and generate a validated, copyable local enquiry; real opt-in sound.
signature.motion: Finite 1.2-second assembly, bounded pointer lighting, scroll separation and character spacing; pause, reduced motion and API fallbacks.
signature.navigation: Visible scenario, workshop and enquiry links; three spatial scenarios become an explicit enquiry selection.
signature.typography: Large open humanist sans invitations paired with restrained serif narrative and measured monospaced object captions.

styles.summary: Seven matte copper plates become a spatial instrument, a sound-character workshop and a practical enquiry brief.

styles.summary: Large architectural photographs, interpretive plans and analytic notes form a project monograph and a contrasting indexed building atlas.
